note: SH1043 — what the console costs to load, before the first row of content. Read by test/console-size-budget.test.mjs against a built ../shio-app/src/main/resources/public, and printed by `pnpm --filter shio-react run size`. Raise a ceiling deliberately and say why in the commit, the way token-budgets.properties has governed the agent's cost since SH113: this is the same rule for the half of the product a person waits for.
seed: SH1043 seeded this at 7473483 raw / 2200187 gzip, and SH1044 spent that number the same day: deleting vite.config.ts's `manualChunks` took it to 1542579 raw / 413169 gzip, because the rule written to keep GraphiQL out of the eager bundle was what put it there. Four entries went with it — vendor-graphiql.js, vendor-graphiql.css, vendor-codemirror.js and vendor-lib.js are no longer eager, and this gate fails on a ceiling that outlives its chunk, which is how they came to be deleted here rather than left as numbers nobody was measuring. The ceilings carry ~5% of room for the reason SH736 gives one gate over: a ceiling set to the measurement refuses the next change instead of measuring it.

index.js.why: the console itself plus the shared vendor code the bundler folded in once `manualChunks` stopped hand-placing it: React, the router and the libraries every route needs

index.css.why: Tailwind's output plus the design system's own sheet

breadcrumb.context.js.why: the design system's shell, which ships pre-hashed and is therefore double-hashed on the way through this build — the case `stemOf` strips repeatedly for

rolldown-runtime.js.why: the bundler's own module runtime, which every other chunk is loaded through
